newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Peres slams as foolish Jerusalem housing plan.
newsitem.headline: Peres slams as foolish Jerusalem housing plan.

text.p: Former Israeli Prime Minister Shimon Peres on Thursday attacked as foolish plans to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
"I think it is a mistake," Peres told a news conference in Seoul during a private visit to the South Korean capital.
"We have the right to build in Jerusalem but we don't have the obligation to be foolish."
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government sent bulldozers last week to break ground for homes for Jews in the Har Homa area of Jerusalem.
"We have built Jerusalem many times without any scandal. Now we build a scandal without any buildings," said Peres, a Nobel peace laureate who was ousted by Netanyahu in polls last May.
Netanyahu opposed Israel's landmark 1993 accord with the Palestine Liberation Organsation (PLO), which Peres helped to engineer.
The Jewish state's settlement policy has angered Arab neighbours and Palestinian peace partners and led to raging violence on the West Bank.
Peres, who heads the opposition Labour party, said a "national unity" government in Israel might be able to advance peace.
"The purpose is not government, the purpose is peace," he said. "Maybe a national unity government can really serve the purpose and advance the peace process," he said
Peres has made no secret of his desire for a government of national unity.
He met South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Thursday and is due to leave the country on Saturday.
